(perf. Raekwon, Inspectah Deck, Method Man) (prod. RZA)
(Cash Rules Everything Around Me, Life's Hectic, Lifestyles Of The Rich, Lifestyles Of The Mega Rich)
Notes: Unfinished version of C.R.E.A.M., made in the same "1993-interview-session" (it's a terrible dub, I know). In an interview with Schott Free for the documentary "Wu-Tang Clan: Of Mics and Men", Schott talks about how he was at the studio session when they recorded C.R.E.A.M. officially for the first time. He said he waited for the track to be finished so he could get it on a cassette. He called the cassette "CREAM: Get The Money". He also partially played the song in the documentary. This version may be the demo for the official release, but that is unconfirmed. It seems as if this version is slightly pitched up, but due to it being a recording it could just be because of the bad quality. Further differences are probably just some mixing changes.
